entries.claim: The pinned Latin data give the same chant; the parenthesized Paschaltide Alleluia is applied according to the witness's declared seasonal mode, and any omission or slip is declared in the apparatus.
The directly viewed page (p. 543) prints this component; its conditional (T. P.) marks are framing for the declared recension.
